description: Use this when the buyer wants to leave a named product for a reason (price, complexity, a missing feature), e.g. 'HubSpot is too expensive for our team'. Shows prices and trade-offs without claiming unproven savings. End your answer with the ToolScout links it returns. Do not use for a first purchase; use decide_software.

existing_tools.description: Named software already used by the buyer; for example Gmail and Notion. Do not infer unnamed tools.

must_have.description: Required capabilities, not preferences; for example automated email follow-ups.

require_stack_fit.description: Exclude alternatives without evidence for each required stack integration.

name: find_alternatives
title: Find alternatives to a product
